HC Mike Vrabel said Monday he won't be available 'in the short term' and doesn't anticipate him back in the next few weeks, promising an update if it proves longer. HC Mike Macdonald said Clark will be out multiple months; the Seahawks placed him on injured reserve Aug. 25 along with OL Mason Richman. GM John Lynch announced Pearsall will have surgery on his PCL and is out for the entire 2026 season; placed on injured reserve. Recurring swelling in the same knee had limited him to two camp practices. 49ers re-signed Deebo Samuel in response.

HC Kyle Shanahan confirmed he is out for the 2026 season. Burden strained his groin on Aug. 8 in red-zone one-on-ones and missed the rest of the preseason, but he was left off Chicago's Week 1 injury report entirely and is expected to play at Carolina. Rome Odunze said this week he expects to line up alongside Burden as the Bears' top two receivers.
